label: Entity
description: A record type, such as Ticket or Vendor: its labels, the field that names a record (titleField), its fields, and the user/group fields that relate people to records for record-level access (accessFields). Entities are the backbone of every view, rule, workflow, and permission. Modules ship base entities; tenants add their own with IDs starting tenant__.
usage: Create a tenant entity only when the data has its own lifecycle and is referenced from several records; otherwise add fields to an existing entity.
Choose a short_text titleField people recognize (a name or title).
Add accessFields for the people who should see records they are named on (requester, owner).
constraints: id is unique in the effective configuration; tenant entities use tenant__<name>, module entities <module>.<area>.<name>.
titleField must be a field of the entity of type short_text or auto_number.
Field keys are unique within the entity; base keys contain no "__" and tenant-added keys start with tenant__.
accessFields must reference user or group fields of the entity.
Entities and fields are never physically removed from a published layer; they are hidden or deprecated so data is kept.
